# Did the new model or prompt break your outputs?

> Paste your saved LLM outputs from before and after a model swap or prompt edit and see which cases broke: invalid JSON, lost keys, new refusals, truncation, lost numbers. Free, runs in your browser, no API key, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/llm-output-regression-diff/)
